title: This Block is a spy!
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fba8bc3f6dac99375cb0e590073fbeca5022099.png)
### About 
This block is a spy! - This is a resource pack that changes the texture of suspicious sand, suspicious gravel, and loose snow to something more visible to the eye so you don't break or fall into them.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ebbd9412e5095c0ec06577de0e99d481d3e16f7.png)
